How to play
Roll the sign die and the number die. Together they make an integer like +4 or −3. Then tap the square where you'll land!
Add the roll to where you are. Adding a negative moves you down toward the deep sea!
Ladders add, snakes subtract. First explorer to reach +50 plants the flag!
